steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B & A
steps.content: Nngh! Aah!! Ow-ow-ow—urgh!

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B
steps.content: Just take the key. Don't hit me, stop! I was wrong! I-I-I promise not to say anything. I'll donate to refugees tomorrow and support the farlands, I-I-I... OOOWW!!!
BWAK!
THUD!
CLANG!
Aurum Secretum gadgets shriek and scatter across the room. Researchers sob and crawl, pleading as they flee.
With Rust cutting through the close quarters and Hypatia unleashing Aurum Secretum from a distance, every guard sent their way is swiftly dismantled.
For the first time, Hypatia feels a raw, electric thrill. All her pent-up restraint shatters. She's free to unleash everything she's held back—no propriety, no decorum, just pure, satisfying payback.
Finally, she draws out a small, untested Aurum Secretum explosive of her own design. Since the invention, she has been waiting for the deployment opportunity.
Cradling it in her palms, she twists the ring, feels the mechanism hum to life, and—as the countdown bleeds its final second—hurls it.
BLAST—THEM—ALL—!!
[Exit Flashback]
The ship bucks violently, slamming Hypatia against her seat and tearing her from sleep.
Outside, night has swallowed the WhiteSands. At the controls, Rust pilots calmly, having just rammed a stray sand worm. He raises his sidearm and puts a round through it without breaking focus.
Right. They won. They gave the researchers a good beating, commandeered a Luminaris ship, and have been on the run ever since.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: How long was I asleep? Have we reached Furor? Did we catch up?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Easy, the main show's over. Why not tidy up first?
He smiles and taps his own cheek. Hypatia freezes, then frantically wipes the corners of her mouth.
Had she overslept? Displayed some undignified habit in plain sight? Surely she hadn't <size=25>drooled</size> or lost her composure?!! Such things were unthinkable in the Campbell household!
The young noble lady's hands move in a flurry, only to pause as her fingers trace her own expression.

Her cheeks feel tight. The corners of her mouth are lifted. She's... smiling. That chaotic escape had followed her into sleep and returned with her to waking, bringing back a smile she had long forgotten.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Seems you had a good dream.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I did.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Thank you.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Don't mention it. We help each other out.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I got myself an apprentice and scratched that spy‑craft itch. I had fun too.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: "An agent's duty is to uphold justice from the shadows!" Isn't that how it goes?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Pfft... Hahahaha!
Rust watches, quietly satisfied, as the rigidity of a Campbell child fractures, and gives way to Hypatia's unguarded, luminous laughing face.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...That's more like it.
The night is ink-dark, stars gleaming like scattered silver. The sand ship cuts through the wind, carving two sharp trails in its wake.
[Scene Change]

Minutes later, the sand ship drifts to a halt in the shadow of a low dune. Ahead stands an abandoned safe house, a few scraggly trees clinging to its sides. The wind has stilled; a deep, watchful silence blankets the landscape. To the horizon, there is no trace of human life—a place that feels removed from all conflict and calculation.
Rust mutters something about needing rest and fuel after a long run, then heads off with their food stash to build a fire. All of it, he notes, was liberated from the Luminaris Society.

Soon, chicken sizzles on the makeshift grill, porridge simmers in an iron pot, and a careful spread of vegetables and fruit sits to the side. Even a sealed canister of drinking water appears. It's a mystery how the small, battered research sand ship ever held so much.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: We've got time. Let's refuel first.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Mm.
Hypatia no longer urges them onward. He's right, of course, as he usually is.
She takes the ear of corn he offers and eats slowly, studying their surroundings. Above, a boundless starfield glitters; below the slope, a few weathered gray stones rest in the shadows.
For the first time in too long, she feels her shoulders loosen, her breath deepen.
And with that ease comes clarity. Her focus sharpens, her senses returning to their old, familiar keenness.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Furor doesn't have sand like this. The terrain is different, too.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Where are we?
She glances toward Rust, but the agent remains absorbed in tending the grill, his focus never leaving the flames.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Weren't we going to Furor?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: What's waiting there will be brutal. Listen to your master: eat first, then move.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: And after that? Where are you taking me?
The words catch in her throat, thick and bitter. Speaking feels like swallowing glass.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...It is Furor, isn't it? You will take me there, won't you, sir? I have to go. I—
The agent finally looks up from the fire. His gaze meets hers, and the silence between them is gentle, almost kind. But Hypatia already knows the answer he hasn't spoken, and it isn't gentle at all.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You're strong, Hypatia. But the battlefield ahead consumes everyone who steps onto it.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: So, it's time I send you away from here.
